# Learn to save a person with blocked airways
In Heimlich Simulator, you can learn to perform the Heimlich maneuver correctly, but there's more! It also includes the initial diagnosis, how to perform back blows, how to handle the person, and what to do after you have succeeded. This is what we call a full-scale scenario!

This type of training is often difficult to access, as it typically requires an expert instructor, a variety of equipment, and a lot of time. Heimlich Simulator makes the training widely available in a simple, intuitive, and customizable way.

AATE VR has partnered with Presto®, a renowned company that provides first aid courses and materials to both consumers and large organizations.

More environments, scenarios, and types of citizens to practice the Heimlich Maneuver on will be added after release.

This application is the Heimlich Simulator – Personal Edition, and is intended for personal use only. For enterprise or educational use, please contact AATE VR at contact[at]aatevr.com.

*You will find free access to 'CPR Simulator' inside the 'Heimlich Simulator' application. We will not be able to do a refund, if you by chance already have purchased the 'CPR Simulator' title ($9.99).
